releaseBoundMs.source: v2: upper bound of the keyboard release; the close completes then even if a chrome still reports the keyboard (a lost chrome event must not leave the overview open)

sheetWidth.source: estimate: Go to Folder and confirmation sheets

typeaheadResetMs.source: estimate: pause that starts a new type-to-select search

bannerTimeout.source: estimate: error banner lifetime in ms

noticeTimeout.source: estimate: transient status notice in ms

dragThreshold.source: estimate: px before a press becomes a drag

thumbnailOversample.source: estimate: thumbnail pixels per icon point (sharp on HiDPI)

hiddenOpacity.source: estimate: hidden files are drawn dimmed when shown

scrollbarIdleOpacity.source: estimate: scroll bar while the view is still

galleryPreviewMargin.source: estimate: space around the gallery preview

sidebarWidth.source: gs-092-232: floating thumbnail panel about 216 px wide at 1.0585 px/pt (about 204 pt) +-4

toolbarHeight.source: gs-092-232: glass capsule groups about 38 tall floating in a band of about 52 (capsule height plus 2 x spacing md)

thumbnailWidth.source: gs-092-232: thumbnail about 150 px wide at 1.0585 px/pt (about 140 pt) inside the 204-pt panel

paper.source: page background of PDF thumbnails (documents are white in both themes)

glanceHeaderHeight.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-015-029): Quick Look header strip 38 +-1

glancePlacementMs.source: estimate: time after its creation during which a Glance follows the output it is mapped on (the compositor reports it within a frame or two); later output changes are user moves

toolbarIconSize.source: estimate: glyph size inside a 28-pt toolbar button (same as files.toolbarIconSize)

infoWidth.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-019-035): inspector panel about 248 +-3 wide

infoRowHeight.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-019-035): inspector info rows 23

glanceGlyphSize.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-015-029): Quick Look close glyph circle 13 +-1

glanceGlyphPitch.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-015-029): glyph circle pitch 20

glanceOpenButtonHeight.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-015-029): the open-with capsule about 135 x 24 +-2

glanceContentInset.source: F1 reference (meas-B, gs-015-029): content inset about 5 +-1.5

slideshowInterval.source: estimate: time one image stays in a slideshow

edgeMargin.source: estimate: smallest gap between the panel and the screen sides on narrow outputs

heightFraction.source: low confidence (not measured): panel height as a share of the output height; 670 px at 1080, about 5.5 rows so the scroll is visible

bottomClearance.source: estimate: space kept free at the bottom of the output for the Dock

padding.source: F1 reference: (844 - 7 x 114.7) / 2 is about 20 pt of side padding

minColumns.source: estimate: fewest columns on a narrow output

minCellWidth.source: estimate: narrowest cell before a column is dropped on a narrow output

labelLines.source: F1 reference: name under the icon, one or two lines

labelLineHeight.source: estimate: label line height relative to the label size

searchHeight.source: estimate: pill search field (Search uses a 48-pt field; F1 low confidence)

chipHeight.source: F1 reference: category chips about 23-24 tall

chipPadding.source: estimate: side padding inside a chip (F1: about 14 around the text)

selectionWidth.source: estimate: keyboard focus ring (same as control.focusRing + 1, F1 reference ring about 3.5)

highlightRadiusScale.source: estimate: hover and focus ring corner radius relative to the icon

scrollbarOpacity.source: estimate: overlay scroll indicator, fill colour at this opacity

scrollbarIdleMs.source: estimate: time the scroll indicator stays after the last scroll

scrollbarMinLengthFactor.source: estimate: shortest scroll indicator, in indicator widths

emptyOffsetFraction.source: estimate: "No results" label, distance from the grid top as a fraction of the grid height

openScale.source: estimate: panel scale at the start of the open animation (Reduce Motion: fade only)

darkSaturation.source: ADR-0014: Dark mode, MultiEffect saturation (-1..1): colours kept as they are

darkBrightness.source: ADR-0014: Dark mode, MultiEffect brightness: a small lift that keeps the dark parts readable after the darkening. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

darkContrast.source: ADR-0014: Dark mode, MultiEffect contrast: keeps the glyph readable on the darker plate. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

darkColorization.source: ADR-0014: Dark mode, strength of the black colorization (multiplies every channel by 1 - this, hue kept). Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

darkShade.source: ADR-0014: Dark mode, colour the icon is darkened towards

clearBrightness.source: ADR-0014: Clear mode, lighter. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

clearContrast.source: ADR-0014: Clear mode, keeps the glyph readable on the grey plate. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

clearOpacity.source: ADR-0014: Clear mode, translucent over the material; A2 keeps meaningful icons at 3:1 or more (measured)

tintedSaturation.source: ADR-0014: Tinted mode, saturation: 0 (MultiEffect desaturates after colorizing, so -1 would grey the tint out; the colorization already maps luminance to the tint)

tintedBrightness.source: ADR-0014: Tinted mode, lifts the shadows so the ramp starts above black. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

tintedContrast.source: ADR-0014: Tinted mode, spreads the luminance over the ramp. Chosen so that icons that have 3:1 between glyph and plate by default keep it (A2, measured on 32 WhiteSur icons: scratch sweep, docs/specs/ui.md).

tintedColorization.source: ADR-0014: Tinted mode, strength of the tint (0..1)

previewSize.source: estimate: Settings icon mode picker, sample icon edge (macOS 26 style tiles)

previewTileWidth.source: estimate: Settings icon mode picker, tile width

previewTileHeight.source: estimate: Settings icon mode picker, tile height

previewRadius.source: estimate: Settings icon mode picker, tile corner radius

previewGap.source: estimate: Settings icon mode picker, gap between tiles

sampleTop.source: own sample icon of the mode previews: top of the plate gradient

sampleBottom.source: own sample icon of the mode previews: bottom of the plate gradient

sampleRadius.source: own sample icon of the mode previews: plate corner radius over its edge

sampleGlyph.source: own sample icon of the mode previews: glyph on the plate

tintColors.source: own picks, not copied: swatches of the Tinted icon colour (blue, purple, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, graphite); the accent is the first swatch

saturation.source: folder colours: MultiEffect saturation (0: the colorization alone sets the hue; MultiEffect desaturates after colorizing)

brightness.source: folder colours: lifts the shading so the recoloured body keeps the lightness of the theme's folder (tuned on WhiteSur folders in the nested session, docs/specs/ui.md)

contrast.source: folder colours: keeps the flap and the body distinct after the colour mapping (tuned on WhiteSur folders)

colorization.source: folder colours: strength of the colour (0..1): the luminance of the folder is mapped onto the colour, shape and shading kept

glyphScale.source: estimate (macOS 26 Customize Folder): symbol or emoji edge over the folder icon edge

glyphCenterY.source: estimate: vertical centre of the symbol over the icon height (the body of the folder, below the flap)

glyphMinContrast.source: A2 (icons >= 3:1): a plain symbol is an engraved shade of the folder's own colour (macOS 26), darkened in the colour's hue until it reaches this contrast against the plate

glyphContrastMargin.source: measured safety over the minimum (the plate is estimated from the colour, the real one differs by a few percent)

plateDefault.source: estimate, only used when the plate cannot be measured (FolderPlate): plate over the folder colour (measured on the fallback theme, tests/visual/folder_glyph_contrast.py), icon mode default and clear

plateDark.source: measured: plate over the folder colour in the Dark icon mode

plateTintedBase.source: measured (two icon tints, dark and light appearance): plate over the folder colour in the Tinted icon mode = base + slope x relative luminance of the icon tint

themeTintedGain.source: measured: in the Tinted icon mode the theme's own folder plate is the icon tint times this

clearLift.source: measured: in the Clear icon mode a dark plate lets the backdrop through (a black folder over a light backdrop): the lightest plate over the colour, as a share of the way to white

themePlate.source: estimate, only used when the plate cannot be measured (FolderPlate): plate of the fallback icon theme folder under the symbol (default mode); the symbol shade otherwise follows the measured plate, any theme

glyphLighterBelow.source: A2 design rule: in the Tinted icon mode the symbol is engraved lighter when the mode's own folder plate (the theme's folder through the mode) has a relative luminance below this (a lighter shade reaches 3.3:1 on plates up to about 0.268), darker otherwise; Dark always lighter, Default and Clear darker

plateSamples.source: estimate: samples per axis of the grid read under the symbol from the raw icon (the plate of every colour, mode and appearance is computed from them)

plateBuckets.source: estimate: icon size buckets of the plate measure (one measure per icon file and bucket); a larger icon uses the last

plateBackdropDark.source: estimate: the view behind a translucent (Clear mode) icon in dark appearance, composited under the plate when its shade is chosen

plateBackdropLight.source: estimate: the view behind a translucent (Clear mode) icon in light appearance

glyphHighlight.source: estimate: 1 px light edge under an engraved symbol (the engraved look)

glyphHighlightOffset.source: estimate: offset of that edge over the icon edge (at least 1 px)

pickerGlyphColumns.source: estimate: Customize Folder, symbol suggestions per row

pickerCell.source: estimate: Customize Folder, side of one symbol suggestion

pickerPreviewSize.source: estimate: Customize Folder, preview icon edge

pitch.source: F1 gap 19: icon pitch about 134 pt

selectionSize.source: F1 gap 19: selection square about 123 pt

selectionRadius.source: estimate: corner radius of the selection square (F1: rounded square, about a fifth of its side)

padding.source: estimate: panel inner margin around the tile grid

nameSize.source: estimate: app name under the selected icon

nameGap.source: estimate: tile grid to app name

edgeMargin.source: estimate: smallest gap between the panel and the screen sides; more apps wrap to a new row

showDelayMs.source: task (macOS model): the panel appears after this long with the modifier held, or at a second Tab; a quick press-release switches without it

layerWaitMs.source: estimate: the chosen app is activated when the compositor reports the switcher surface unmapped; if no such event arrives within this time it is activated anyway

fadeScale.source: estimate: panel scale at the start of the open animation (Reduce Motion: fade only)

crossfadeMs.source: ADR-0016: crossfade between two pictures of a carousel (macOS: ASSUMPTION, check against design/reference); Reduce Motion shortens it to motion.reducedMax

toolTimeoutMs.source: ADR-0016: a grassfield-wallpaper prepare that runs longer than this is killed (a 24 MP JPEG takes under a second)

listTimeoutMs.source: ADR-0016: a folder listing that runs longer than this is killed (a hung network mount never blocks the shell)

changeDebounceMs.source: ADR-0016: quiet time after the last settings change before a picture is prepared (a colour well dragged for a second makes one job)

cacheMaxBytes.source: ADR-0016 (owner answers): LRU cap of the prepared-picture cache, 512 MiB

maxListEntries.source: ADR-0016: pictures read from one folder

stateWriteMs.source: ADR-0016: quiet time before the carousel position is written to the state file

releaseHoldMs.source: estimate (motion.fast): an Exclusive surface drops its keyboard first and stays mapped this long before it unmaps, so Hyprland sees the release while the surface still exists (a layer destroyed while Exclusive leaves no keyboard focus at all); the fade of Search and Apps runs in it
